amenity.description: Buyer-facing presentation metadata for one amenity identifier. The containing map key, not this metadata, defines amenity identity and filter matching.

description.description: Short, plain-text, buyer-facing label or phrase for the amenity, suitable for direct use in a compact list (e.g., 'Curbside pickup'). The Business SHOULD localize it for the request when possible. This content does not participate in amenity identity or filter matching.

amenity.title: Amenity

description: The full, rich representation of a physical business location. Builds on the Location Summary schema with discovery-centric details such as geographic coordinates, operating hours, timezone, and amenities.
